verses.text: [“] Man, born of a woman, [is] short of days and full of trouble.

segments.text: [“] Man, born of a woman, [is] short of days and full of trouble.

verses.text: Like a flower he comes forth and withers, and he flees like a shadow, and does not stand.

verses.text: And upon this one do You open Your eyes; and bring me into judgment with You?

verses.text: Who will bring clean from unclean? Not one!

verses.text: Since his days are determined, the number of his months [is] with You; his limits You have made, and he cannot pass over [them].

verses.text: Look away from him that he may rest, until he can enjoy his day like a hireling.

verses.text: For there is hope for a tree, if it is cut down, that again it will pass through, and its tender shoots will not cease.

verses.text: And a man dies and is laid low; and a man expires, and where [is] he?

verses.text: If a man dies, will he live? All the days of my hardship, I will wait, until the coming of my change.
